bio.text: Ricardo Cabrera is the Republican candidate for California's 51st Congressional District in 2026.
Cabrera earned a bachelor's degree from Grand Canyon University in 2024 and a graduate degree from the same university in 2026, and has worked as a chief executive officer.
In the Ballotpedia candidate survey, Cabrera self-describes as a San Diegan, small business owner and cybersecurity professional.
